notes: No game type is described — this is a citadel room, a place rather than a genre — so it routes through no-genre rather than an invented one.

Explorable Place kept whole, but the enclosure axis is interior-only rather than the preset's default exterior, since the whole map is one sealed lab room. Still routes P0; interior-only carries no P3.
No building-interior pick: the map is itself the interior, so there is no outside-to-inside transition to generate.

The requested exposed attributes — tank glow colour, pod count, room size, fog intensity — are build-time parameters with nowhere to live in this handoff; passing them on for whoever wires up the room.
No count emitted for pods or room size: the prompt asks for those as tunable attributes and never states a number.
